title: Ampleness descends and ascends along finite surjective morphisms
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] proper over $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $f:Y\to X$ be an $R$-morphism which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and surjective on underlying spaces [def-weil-surjective-morphism]. For every invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], one has that $\mathcal L$ is ample on $X$ if and only if $f^*\mathcal L$ is ample on $Y$, where pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback] and both occurrences of ample mean the absolute affine-nonvanishing-locus condition [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module].

proof.text: A finite morphism is affine [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], so [lem-weil-pbc-pullback-ample-invertible] proves ascent. Pullback is invertible by [lem-weil-pbc-invertible-pullback-tensor](1). For descent assume $f^*\mathcal L$ ample. The affine base $\operatorname{Spec}R$ is locally Noetherian by its chart [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-spec-basic-opens-unit-ideal-quasi-compact](iii). Proper morphisms are finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism], so [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] makes $X,Y$ Noetherian.

source.place: Tag 0B5V, lemma-surjective-finite-morphism-ample, ascent and Noetherian setup

proof.text: For coherent $\mathcal E$ put $\mathcal P(\mathcal E)\iff\exists n_0\ge0\;\forall n\ge n_0\;\forall p>0,\ H^p(X,\mathcal E\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})=0$. This is $\mathcal P_{\mathcal L}$ of [lem-trf-twisted-cohomology-devissage-closure], which supplies its zero case, extension closure and descent from a nonempty finite sum, conditions (0)-(2) of devissage.

For each integral closed $Z\subseteq X$ with generic point $\xi$, [lem-weil-pbc-finite-surjective-coherent-generic-support] gives coherent $\mathcal F$ on $Y$ with $\mathcal G=f_*\mathcal F$ supported exactly on $Z$ and $\mathfrak m_\xi\mathcal G_\xi=0$. By [lem-trf-finite-ideal-twist-cohomology-comparison](1) with $\mathcal J=\mathcal O_X$, $\mathcal G$ is coherent. Fix any quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal J$ with $\mathcal J_\xi=\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$. The same comparison gives coherent $\mathcal H=f^{-1}\mathcal J\cdot\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal J\mathcal G=f_*\mathcal H$; its cohomology isomorphisms identify the twists of $\mathcal J\mathcal G$ on $X$ with those of $\mathcal H$ by $(f^*\mathcal L)^{\otimes n}$ on $Y$. Since $Y$ is proper over $R$ and $f^*\mathcal L$ invertible and ample, [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-serre-vanishing] gives, for this fixed ideal, $n_0(\mathcal J)\ge0$ such that the groups vanish for every $n\ge n_0(\mathcal J)$ and every $p>0$, hence $\mathcal P_{\mathcal L}(\mathcal J\mathcal G)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk](2), $(\mathcal J\mathcal G)_\xi=\mathcal J_\xi\mathcal G_\xi=\mathcal G_\xi$ through the inclusion. Take the coherent $\mathcal G'=\mathcal J\mathcal G$, with its identity inclusion into $\mathcal J\mathcal G$; the comparison supplies its coherence, and the stalk equality verifies (3)(c). Conditions (3)(a),(b) hold for $\mathcal G$.

source.place: Tag 0B5V, lemma-surjective-finite-morphism-ample, condition (3) and displayed vanishing comparison

proof.text: All hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-property-devissage-integral-subschemes] now hold; therefore every coherent module has $\mathcal P_{\mathcal L}$. The structure sheaf is quasi-coherent of finite type, hence coherent by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth]; every quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal I$ is coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-kernel-cokernel-locnoeth](2). Its vanishing bound gives $H^1(X,\mathcal I\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})=0$ for $n\ge\max(1,n_0)$. Apply [lem-trf-ideal-twist-vanishing-implies-ample] to conclude $\mathcal L$ ample.

Delta from the previous head 3a9f: both new nodes are byte-identical to all four earlier heads. In the item only one sentence of Step 3 changed: G'=JG is now taken with its inclusion into JG. That is correct, since devissage (3)(c) asks for G' contained in JG with G'_xi=G_xi. Re-split: old steps 1-2 became Step 1. Old step 3 became the whole of lem-trf-twisted-cohomology-devissage-closure. The coherence and JG=f_*H part of old step 4, all of old step 5 and the H^p chain of old step 6 became lem-trf-finite-ideal-twist-cohomology-comparison. The witness choice, Serre vanishing with one n_0(J) for all p>0 and the generic stalk equality stay in Step 3, and old step 7 became Step 4. Nothing was dropped, the two nodes have 1643 and 2303 characters, neither restates the item, and the assembly has 2855 characters. All hypotheses check: finite implies affine, which gives ascent; f^*L is invertible by invertible-pullback-tensor(1); X and Y are Noetherian by finite-type-over-noetherian; generic support needs only X locally Noetherian; G is coherent (comparison with J=O_X) before J is quantified; Y is proper over Noetherian R with f^*L ample, so Serre vanishing applies; n>=max(1,n_0) gives the hypothesis of lem-trf-ideal-twist-vanishing-implies-ample.
